blocks.title: Problems We Solve
blocks.subTitle: The work your team keeps redoing | caught, sorted and drafted for you
blocks.content: Almost every one of these follows the same shape | something arrives, it's read and sorted, a reply or entry is drafted — and held for you | . | We take the repetitive slice | the deciding, the researching, the judgement stays with you | .. | Some work is only ever partly automatable | where a person must investigate or decide — a root-cause review, a quality programme — | we take the measurable, repeatable part and say plainly where you stay in charge | . | Most requests cross more than one area | an order query can mean a message, a stock check and a return at once | . | We assemble the right pieces behind the scenes | so your customer gets one smooth reply | .. | Start with the one that's costing you hours | and grow from there | .

groups.label: Communication & Customers
groups.intro: Enquiries, questions, bookings and feedback — caught, sorted and drafted for reply, so nothing slips through and nothing goes out without your say-so.

items.label: Communication & Intake
items.problem: Enquiries arrive by form, email and voicemail, sometimes in more than one language — and some get missed while replies stay inconsistent.
items.handled: We pull every enquiry into one list, sort it by language and type, and prepare a polite holding reply for each. You approve the replies and make the judgement calls; nothing is sent on its own.

items.label: Customer Support
items.problem: Your support inbox fills with the same order-status, returns and how-to questions, and the urgent ones get buried.
items.handled: We sort each message by what it's asking, draft an answer from your own saved responses, and flag anything urgent. You approve every reply, and anything complex or out-of-policy comes straight to a person.

items.label: Scheduling & Booking
items.problem: Booking requests come in after hours, so reception replies late or double-books — and no-shows quietly cost you.
items.handled: We check your calendar, draft a confirmation or a couple of alternative times, and send reminders before each appointment. You approve what goes out; the calendar is only updated once you or the customer confirm.

items.label: Feedback & Reviews
items.problem: Feedback lands scattered across email, review sites and surveys — praise gets missed and complaints are answered too late.
items.handled: We gather it in one place, sort it by mood and topic, and draft a suitable response — a thank-you, a reply, or a note to the right person. You approve every response, and complaints that need real care go to you, not a script.

groups.label: Sales & Growth
groups.intro: From first interest to renewal — leads sorted, quotes drafted, follow-ups never forgotten — with you deciding what's sent and what's sold.

items.label: Lead & Sales Pipeline
items.problem: Leads come in from forms, events and referrals, but they all get chased equally — so the promising ones don't get priority and stalled deals are quietly forgotten.
items.handled: We gather each lead, add what we can find about them, and sort them into hot, worth-nurturing, or not-a-fit — with a draft introduction ready for the promising ones, and a nudge when a deal goes quiet. You decide who's worth pursuing and do the selling; we just make sure nothing is dropped.

items.label: Content & Marketing
items.problem: There's never time to turn one good piece of content into posts and a newsletter, and the questions customers keep asking never become marketing.
items.handled: We take a piece you've approved and draft versions for your other channels, and turn recurring customer questions into ready-to-use content ideas. You keep the final say on voice and what gets published; nothing goes out in your name without your edit and approval.

items.label: E-commerce & Fulfilment
items.problem: Most orders are fine, but stock-outs, wrong addresses and unusually large orders slip through — and the returns inbox mixes refunds, warranty claims and out-of-policy requests.
items.handled: We screen every order and flag the ones that need a human eye, drafting a customer notice where one's needed, and we sort each return and prepare the right reply. You approve the customer messages and make the refund and warranty decisions.

items.label: Quotes & Proposals
items.problem: Quotes get built by hand from scattered price lists, so they go out late or with mistakes.
items.handled: We read each request, match it to your products and prices, and draft the quote from your template — or draft a question back if something's missing. You set the pricing and any discounts, and approve the quote before it's sent.

items.label: Renewals & Retention
items.problem: Renewals quietly lapse and customers drift away, because nobody's tracking what's due or spotting the early warning signs.
items.handled: We keep an eye on upcoming renewals and accounts that look at-risk, and draft a timely reminder or a note to win them back, flagging the account to you. You have the retention conversation and make any commercial decisions; we just make sure the moment isn't missed.

groups.label: Documents & Finance
groups.intro: The paperwork that piles up — invoices, contracts, filings, supplier bills — read, sorted and prepared, with every payment and sign-off kept firmly in your hands.

items.label: Document & Data Processing
items.problem: Invoices, receipts, contracts and delivery notes arrive as PDFs, photos and post — and get retyped by hand, then are hard to find later.
items.handled: We read each document, pull out the key details, and file it where it belongs, with a draft entry ready for your accounts. Anything the system isn't sure about, or that doesn't fit the usual pattern, is set aside for you to check rather than guessed at.

items.label: Finance & Admin
items.problem: Finance manually gathers each week's due invoices and checks expense claims one by one — slow, and easy to mis-pay.
items.handled: We collect the invoices that are due, match them up, and prepare the payment list for you; we also check expense claims against your policy and draft the reply. You give the final go-ahead on any payment — the money never moves without your sign-off — and the accounting judgement stays yours.

items.label: Contracts & Agreements
items.problem: Signed contracts pile up and renewal or notice dates get missed, so you're stuck with auto-renewals you didn't want.
items.handled: We read each contract, pull out the key terms and dates, and keep a register that reminds you before anything falls due. The legal reading, the negotiating, and the decision to renew or walk away all stay with you — we just make sure a date never catches you out.

items.label: Procurement & Suppliers
items.problem: Matching supplier invoices to purchase orders and deliveries is done by hand, so overbilling and duplicate payments slip through.
items.handled: We check each invoice against your purchase order and delivery record, queue up the ones that match, and flag anything that doesn't to the right person. You approve every payment and handle any dispute or supplier negotiation yourself.

items.label: Compliance & Filing
items.problem: Every VAT period turns into a scramble to pull the figures together, with deadlines uncomfortably close.
items.handled: We gather the transactions, assemble a draft return, run the consistency checks, and remind you well before the deadline, keeping a full record for your files. The figures are always yours to review and approve, and the formal responsibility — the tax judgement and the filing itself — stays with you and your accountant. We prepare the groundwork; we don't file on your behalf or stand in for professional advice.

groups.label: Operations & Insight
groups.intro: The behind-the-scenes work that keeps things moving — coordinating tasks, pulling reports, screening applicants, watching quality and keeping know-how written down — with the judgement and the decisions kept with your team.

items.label: Internal Operations
items.problem: Onboarding a new joiner, or handling everyday requests for access, equipment and facilities, means chasing several people — and steps get missed or lost in a shared inbox.
items.handled: We build the checklist, assign each step to the right person, send the reminders, and track it through to done — and we sort incoming requests and route them to whoever owns them, with a quick acknowledgement drafted. Your team does the work and makes the calls on exceptions; we keep it all moving so nothing's forgotten.

items.label: Reporting & Analytics
items.problem: Someone loses hours every cycle pulling the same figures into a report — and problems in the numbers are often spotted too late.
items.handled: We gather the figures, assemble your standard report, and check it over before handing you a draft — and we keep an eye on the numbers between reports, alerting you when something crosses a line you care about. Reading the numbers and deciding what to do about them stays with you; we just get the report onto your desk, and the warning to you in time.

items.label: People & Hiring
items.problem: A job ad floods the inbox, and screening applications and arranging interviews by hand is slow — so good candidates go cold.
items.handled: We acknowledge each application, check it against your must-have criteria, and either propose interview times for the strong ones or draft a courteous decline for the rest, keeping track of where everyone stands. The shortlisting judgement, the interviews and the hiring decision are entirely yours — we handle the admin around them, never the choice of who to hire.

items.label: Quality & Process Monitoring
items.problem: A quality or improvement effort needs steady measurement to work, but the data is gathered by hand and problems surface late.
items.handled: We take the ongoing measurement off your hands — collecting the data regularly, tracking it against the levels you've set, and flagging anything that drifts out of range, with the context, to the right person. Defining the problem, finding the root cause and deciding what to change stay with you and your team — we provide the steady measurement, not the improvement programme itself.

items.label: Knowledge & SOPs
items.problem: Staff keep asking the same 'how do we do X', and the answers live in people's heads or scattered documents.
items.handled: We search what's already written, draft an answer from the source, and where there's a gap, draft a starting point for a new written procedure and flag it to the right owner. You decide what's accurate and official; we keep the shared know-how findable and current, but the authoritative word is always yours to approve.

blocks.challenge: High volume of mixed inbound email inquiries — leads, technical questions, and noise — required manual reading, classification, and routing daily. Inconsistent handling and missed messages were a recurring problem.
blocks.built: AI classification of all inbound email into actionable categories. Automatic CRM logging. Draft replies prepared for relevant inquiries. Human review and approval on every outbound action.
blocks.result: Zero emails missed or misrouted. Staff time freed from manual sorting. Human decision retained on every reply. Consistent handling from day one.

blocks.quote: Nothing gets lost now, and nothing goes out that I haven't seen.

blocks.challenge: Incoming supplier invoices and client contracts arrived in varying formats — PDF, scanned paper, email attachments. Each required manual reading, data extraction, and re-entry into the accounting system. The process absorbed 6–8 hours per week and produced recurring data-entry errors.
blocks.built: Automated extraction of key data fields from incoming documents. Validation against supplier master records. Structured output prepared for accounting system import. Human review triggered only on exceptions and anomalies — not on every document.
blocks.result: Weekly processing time reduced from 6–8 hours to under one hour. Data entry errors near-eliminated. Staff attention redirected from data transfer to decisions.
